Local ownership. Lower prices.

Fence Wizards is a smaller, family-owned business. Buying material directly and running our own crew helps us keep prices competitive with large national rental companies.

Send a comparable written quote if you have one. Richard can look at the scope and tell you how our price compares.

What goes into your quote

The site address, fence type, linear footage, gates, and rental duration determine the starting price. Windscreen, extra ballast, asphalt posts, and other accessories can add to it. Ground conditions, access, and timing also affect the work involved.

New installations 50 miles or more outside Indianapolis carry a $1-per-linear-foot surcharge on the current price sheet. Richard needs to confirm how that distance is measured. If the distance is unknown, the online estimate leaves that surcharge out and flags it for review.

What the flat fee covers

Delivery, installation, rental for the agreed term, and final removal are included in the project quote. The current base pricing covers up to 12 months for panels and stands, and up to 18 months for post-driven fencing. Longer rentals have separate rate bands.

A delay within the agreed term does not start a monthly rent charge. If the job will run beyond that term, contact Richard before it ends. Ask about short-job and event discounts; Richard confirms the amount for your project.

Gates, screen, and changes to the layout

Standard gates are included with panels and stands. For post-driven fencing, the current sheet lists single gates at $140 and double gates at $280. Extra-wide fabricated gates, gate wheels, and chains and locks are priced separately.

Plain and printed windscreen are purchased, not rented. Screened panels may need additional ballast; Richard will confirm the stand count and sandbags required. Moving fencing or adding gates after installation is a change to the original scope and can involve separate labor and call-out charges.

An estimate first. A confirmed quote next.

The online planner uses your footage and selections to show a preliminary, pre-tax estimate. It is not a confirmed booking or final price. Richard reviews the site, schedule, accessories, and any items flagged for confirmation before you agree to the work.

Some rental durations and specialty requests need a custom quote. Tax and any minimum charge for a new installation still need confirmation and are not included in the planner. Emergency work and changes to an existing installation are reviewed separately.

Payment and proposals

Richard can quote verbally on the phone, followed by a written proposal. Net 30 is available for vetted accounts and established clients. Smaller or unvetted accounts pay up front; the applicable terms are discussed at the start.

Damaged equipment can carry replacement or repair charges, as listed on the price sheet. Ask Richard about those terms and the optional damage waiver before agreeing to the rental; the waiver is not included automatically.

Pricing questions

Do you price fencing by the foot?

Yes. Fence type, footage, and rental duration set the base price. Gates, accessories, distance, and site requirements can change the total. The agreed quote covers the complete scope.

Is windscreen a rental?

No. Plain and custom printed windscreen are sold and stay yours.

Can I plan my fence online?

Yes. Sketch your fence layout or enter known footage to explore preliminary pricing. This preview does not yet include Google Maps or online quote submission. Contact Richard to request a confirmed quote.
